data.name: eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT
data.detailed_description:
A New Series Is Coming

◆ The latest entry in the Professional Baseball Spirits series, "eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT 2026" has arrived.

Experience realistic baseball powered by the eBaseball™ Engine.

【DETAIL】Lifelike hair and skin textures

Attention to detail brings every moment to life.

【ACTION】Baseball movement

Recreates the flight of the ball as you see it in the stadium, along with the players' subtle movements, all with incredible detail.

【STADIUM】Overwhelming surge of excitement

Stadiums are recreated with laser-scan precision, and each ballpark's signature fireworks show brings your games to life.

【SOUND】Immersive audio experience

Stadium acoustics are recreated with precision using impulse response (IR)* measurements, capturing every rich echo of the real venues.

Immersive spatial audio delivers lifelike sound that makes you feel as if you're truly inside the stadium.

*Data capturing the acoustic characteristics of a real location.

◆ Variety of Game Modes

【Exhibition】Nail-biting, high-intensity games

Start by jumping into Versus Mode to fully experience the realistic baseball powered by the eBaseball™ Engine.

Set your stadium, rules, and more, then enjoy an intense matchup with your favorite team.

【Season】Build a winning team

Manage personnel and make strategic decisions with future roster turnover in mind to build a consistently winning team, now with the Active Player Draft included.

【Star Player】Aim to become a star

Use the detailed player customization system to fine‑tune your player, and live out up to 30 years of a pro baseball career with a player built to your liking.

Devote yourself entirely to baseball or enrich your personal life as you aim to become a star of the baseball world.

【Hakkyu no Kiseki】Coach a high school team to a national title

Train your players through daily practice and in‑game tactical decisions as you experience a new era of high school baseball with the DH rule now in place.

With new first‑years joining and third‑years graduating each season, build your program into a powerhouse capable of reaching Koshien and winning it all.

◆ Plus a variety of other modes!

[Included Game Modes]

・Exhibition

・Season

・Star Player

・Hakkyu no Kiseki

・Spirits

・Live Championship

・Live Scenario

・Grand Prix

・Home Run Contest

・Team Edit

・Edit Share

and more!


About the Game

eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT

Powered by the next generation eBaseball™ Engine, the game delivers lifelike motion and sound throughout the stadium.

From the flight of the ball and the players giving their all to the explosive cheers of the crowd, every moment comes alive with immersive detail. Combined with smooth, live-style play-by-play commentary*, the experience brings you closer than ever to real baseball.

*Color commentary is unavailable in English.

The eBaseball™ Engine takes baseball games to a new dimension

This next-generation visual experience is powered by Unreal® Engine, enabling highly realistic details. Hair and skin textures appear almost tangible, and even the rain that falls onto the field is rendered with impressive authenticity.

【WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP】Challenge Rivals from Around the World in Online Matches

Build your own original team and compete online against players from across the globe.

Sharpen your skills through intense matches and aim for the top of the rankings.

【EXHIBITION】Enjoy Next-Generation Baseball to the Fullest

In Exhibition mode, you can take your time and enjoy next-generation baseball with your favorite teams.

Customize match settings and rules, hone your skills, or experience realistic baseball together with friends.

【TEAM EDIT】Build Your Ideal Team with Carefully Selected Players

In WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP, each tournament features regulations such as cost limits.

Use TEAM EDIT to carefully choose from a wide roster of players and build a team capable of advancing through the competition.

About the Professional Baseball Spirits Series

eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT is a title in the Professional Baseball Spirits series.

The Professional Baseball Spirits series is a professional baseball game franchise dedicated to realism. The first home console title, Professional Baseball Spirits 2004, was released on March 25, 2004.

With Professional Baseball Spirits 2015, the series introduced 3D scanning technology, capturing real professional baseball players from every angle to recreate them in three dimensions. Laser scanning technology was also adopted to precisely measure and reproduce stadium layouts, delivering an exceptionally realistic baseball experience.

The mobile game Professional Baseball Spirits A, released in 2015, has celebrated its 10th anniversary and surpassed 65 million total downloads as of February 2026.

data.short_description: Experience authentic baseball with players from around the world. Feel the arc of every hit, the intensity behind each play, and the roar of the crowd surrounding the stadium. With stunning presentation, the game captures the true intensity of real baseball.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500 / AMD Ryzen5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX1060(6GB) / Radeon RX470 *4GB VRAM required
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: – Supported Devices Xbox 360 controller, Xbox One controller, Xbox Series X/S controller, PlayStation 4 wireless controller (DUALSHOCK 4), PlayStation 5 wireless controller (DualSense)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX3060Ti / Radeon RX6700XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: – Supported Devices Xbox 360 controller, Xbox One controller, Xbox Series X/S controller, PlayStation 4 wireless controller (DUALSHOCK 4), PlayStation 5 wireless controller (DualSense)
